title: just tad of quality issue, but these jars work well.
text: just tad of quality issue, but these jars work well.. a few came with a few chips at the next of the jars, and they were not as clear as I had hoped.  That said, it was good to get proper lids as well, but wished they had 1/2 and 1/2 as I thought it tad wasteful.  We use these jars to make salad dressing, transfer small amounts of pasta sauce from the original large jars, feeding the sourdough starter, and hence there are many greta uses.  The inside of the jar is not flat, but domes up, so  I couldn't use it as a tea light candle holder.
